data.name: Whipped Ricotta Toast
data.description: Whipped ricotta on grilled sourdough with hot honey and cracked black pepper.
data.sellingLine: Something to share while you look at the menu: warm toast, cool ricotta, a little heat from the honey.
talkingPoints: Ricotta is whipped to order so it stays light.
The honey is infused with Calabrian chili.
Easy to share for two to four guests.
data.say: “Something to share while you look at the menu: warm toast, cool ricotta, a little heat from the honey.”
data.inspiration: A snack from the chef’s first trip to Sicily, where ricotta came warm from the dairy.
sellingPoints: Whipped to order, so it stays light
Calabrian chili honey made in house
Easy to share for two to four

steps.title: Whip the ricotta
steps.detail: Whip ricotta with olive oil and salt until smooth and airy.

steps.title: Grill the bread
steps.detail: Brush sourdough with oil and grill until marked on both sides.

steps.title: Build
steps.detail: Swoosh the ricotta across each slice, edge to edge.

steps.title: Finish
steps.detail: Drizzle hot honey, crack pepper over, cut on the bias.

data.name: Crispy Calamari
data.description: Lightly fried calamari with lemon aioli and Calabrian chili.
data.sellingLine: Crisp and light, with a squeeze of lemon. A great start with a glass of white.
talkingPoints: Dredged in rice flour for a lighter crunch.
Calamari is a mollusc: flag it for shellfish allergies.
data.say: “Crisp and light, with a squeeze of lemon. A great start with a glass of white.”
data.inspiration: The bar snack every table orders, made lighter with a rice-flour dredge.
sellingPoints: Rice flour keeps it crisp, not heavy
Lemon aioli made fresh each morning

steps.title: Soak
steps.detail: Soak calamari in buttermilk for at least an hour.

steps.title: Dredge
steps.detail: Shake off, toss in the rice-flour dredge, tap off the extra.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Fry at 350°F until pale gold and crisp.

steps.title: Season and plate
steps.detail: Salt straight from the fryer, toss with the peppers.

data.name: Meatballs al Forno
data.description: Beef and pork meatballs baked in San Marzano tomato with parmesan and basil.
data.sellingLine: Three meatballs, baked to order in tomato. Perfect with a glass of Chianti.
talkingPoints: Baked in the oven, never fried.
The sauce simmers for four hours.
data.say: “Three meatballs, baked to order in tomato. Perfect with a glass of Chianti.”
data.inspiration: Sunday supper at the chef’s grandmother’s, baked in the same dish they’re served in.
sellingPoints: Beef, pork and veal, rolled by hand
Baked in the sauce, so they stay tender

steps.title: Roll
steps.detail: Mix the meat, soaked bread and cheese gently; roll into 2 oz balls.

steps.title: Brown
steps.detail: Roast at 450°F until browned outside.

steps.title: Braise
steps.detail: Finish in the tomato sauce at a low simmer.

steps.title: Fire to order
steps.detail: Three meatballs and sauce in a cast-iron dish, top with mozzarella, into the oven.

steps.title: Finish
steps.detail: Basil and grated cheese over, bread on the side.

data.name: Burrata & Heirloom Tomato
data.description: Fresh burrata with heirloom tomatoes, basil oil and flaky salt.
data.sellingLine: Creamy burrata with the best tomatoes of the week. Light and bright.
talkingPoints: Burrata is cut at the table.
data.say: “Creamy burrata with the best tomatoes of the week. Light and bright.”
data.inspiration: A summer plate that lives or dies on the tomatoes, so it’s built simply.
sellingPoints: Tomatoes salted ten minutes before plating

steps.title: Cut tomatoes
steps.detail: Cut into wedges and rounds; salt and rest.

steps.title: Arrange
steps.detail: Lay tomatoes in a loose ring.

steps.title: Burrata
steps.detail: Set the burrata in the centre and tear it open.

steps.title: Finish
steps.detail: Basil oil, flaky salt and black pepper.

data.name: Little Gem Caesar
data.description: Little gem lettuce, anchovy dressing, parmesan and garlic crumbs.
data.sellingLine: Our take on the classic: crisp little gems and a punchy anchovy dressing.
talkingPoints: The dressing has anchovy: not vegetarian.
Add chicken or salmon on request.
data.say: “Our take on the classic: crisp little gems and a punchy anchovy dressing.”
data.inspiration: The classic Caesar, with crisp little gems instead of romaine.
sellingPoints: Ask about a version without croutons

steps.title: Dress
steps.detail: Toss leaves with the dressing until every leaf is coated.

steps.title: Stack
steps.detail: Stand the leaves up in the bowl, tallest in back.

steps.title: Finish
steps.detail: Croutons, grated parmesan and black pepper.

data.name: Farro & Arugula Salad
data.description: Warm farro, arugula, roasted squash, pecorino and toasted pepitas.
data.sellingLine: Hearty but fresh: warm farro and squash with bright lemon.
talkingPoints: Farro is an ancient wheat: contains gluten.
Vegetarian; ask to hold the pecorino for vegan.
data.say: “Hearty but fresh: warm farro and squash with bright lemon.”
data.inspiration: A hearty grain salad that holds its own as a light main.
sellingPoints: Add chicken or salmon for a main

steps.title: Cook the farro
steps.detail: Simmer in salted water until just tender; cool on a sheet tray.

steps.title: Roast the squash
steps.detail: Toss in oil and salt, roast at 425°F until caramelised.

steps.title: Toss to order
steps.detail: Farro, squash and vinaigrette first, then fold in the arugula.

steps.title: Finish
steps.detail: Shaved pecorino and toasted seeds.

data.name: Margherita
data.description: San Marzano tomato, fresh mozzarella and basil on our naturally leavened dough.
data.sellingLine: The classic, done right: our dough rests for 48 hours before it hits the oven.
talkingPoints: Baked at about 800°F in under two minutes.
data.say: “The classic, done right: our dough rests for 48 hours before it hits the oven.”
data.inspiration: The pizza that tests every pizzeria: dough, tomato, mozzarella, basil.

components.hold: Room temp, under a damp towel

steps.title: Stretch
steps.detail: Press from the middle out, leaving a 1-inch rim.

steps.title: Top
steps.detail: Sauce in a spiral, mozzarella torn and spread out.

steps.title: Bake
steps.detail: Bake on the deck, turning once, until the rim is leopard-spotted.

steps.title: Finish
steps.detail: Basil, olive oil, cut in six.

data.name: Hot Honey Soppressata
data.description: Spicy soppressata, mozzarella, tomato and a drizzle of hot honey.
data.sellingLine: Sweet heat: crisp soppressata cups with hot honey over the top.
talkingPoints: Pairs well with an off-dry white.
data.say: “Sweet heat: crisp soppressata cups with hot honey over the top.”
data.inspiration: Sweet, spicy and salty on one pie; the late-night favourite.
sellingPoints: Soppressata cups and crisps in the oven
Hot honey added after the bake

steps.title: Stretch
steps.detail: Press from the middle out, leaving a rim.

steps.title: Top
steps.detail: Sauce, mozzarella, then soppressata edge to edge.

steps.title: Bake
steps.detail: Bake until the soppressata cups and crisps.

steps.title: Finish
steps.detail: Hot honey zigzag, cut in six.

data.name: Cacio e Pepe
data.description: Tonnarelli with pecorino romano and toasted black pepper.
data.sellingLine: Three ingredients, done perfectly: pecorino, pepper and fresh pasta.
talkingPoints: Pasta is made fresh daily with egg.
Finished in the pan, so it takes about 8 minutes.
data.say: “Three ingredients, done perfectly: pecorino, pepper and fresh pasta.”
data.inspiration: Three ingredients and all technique: pasta, pecorino, pepper.
sellingPoints: The sauce is just cheese, pepper and pasta water

steps.title: Toast the pepper
steps.detail: Toast cracked pepper in a dry pan until fragrant.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.detail: Boil until just short of done; save the water.

steps.title: Emulsify
steps.detail: Off the heat, toss pasta with pecorino and pasta water until glossy.

steps.title: Plate
steps.detail: Twist into a nest, more pecorino and pepper on top.

data.name: Rigatoni alla Vodka
data.description: Rigatoni in a creamy tomato vodka sauce with Calabrian chili and parmesan.
data.sellingLine: Our signature pasta: creamy, a little spicy, and big enough to share.
talkingPoints: The vodka cooks off; no alcohol remains.
data.say: “Our signature pasta: creamy, a little spicy, and big enough to share.”
data.inspiration: The creamy tomato pasta guests come back for.
sellingPoints: Vodka cooks off; the sauce keeps its body

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.detail: Sweat shallot, add tomato paste and chili, deglaze with vodka, finish with cream.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.detail: Finish the rigatoni in boiling water.

steps.title: Toss
steps.detail: Toss pasta in the sauce with a splash of pasta water.

steps.title: Finish
steps.detail: Parmesan and torn basil.

data.name: Lobster Tagliatelle
data.description: Fresh tagliatelle with Maine lobster, cherry tomato and brown butter.
data.sellingLine: Sweet lobster with brown butter. Our special-occasion pasta.
talkingPoints: About 4 oz of lobster per plate.
data.say: “Sweet lobster with brown butter. Our special-occasion pasta.”
data.inspiration: The special-occasion pasta: lobster, butter, a little chili.
sellingPoints: Whole lobster tail, poached in butter

steps.title: Poach
steps.detail: Poach the lobster gently in butter until just opaque.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.detail: Boil the tagliatelle until just tender.

steps.title: Toss
steps.detail: Toss with lobster butter, lemon and a splash of pasta water.

steps.title: Plate
steps.detail: Pasta nest, lobster on top, chives over.

data.name: Chicken Parmesan
data.description: A crisp breaded chicken cutlet with tomato, mozzarella and a side of spaghetti.
data.sellingLine: The comfort classic: a big crispy cutlet with melted mozzarella.
talkingPoints: Pounded thin and fried to order.
data.say: “The comfort classic: a big crispy cutlet with melted mozzarella.”
data.inspiration: An Italian-American classic, pounded thin and fried to order.
sellingPoints: Served with rigatoni in tomato sauce

steps.title: Bread
steps.detail: Pound thin, then flour, egg and breadcrumbs.

steps.title: Fry
steps.detail: Pan-fry until golden on both sides.

steps.title: Melt
steps.detail: Sauce and mozzarella on top; under the broiler until bubbling.

steps.title: Plate
steps.detail: Cutlet beside the rigatoni, basil over.

plating.name: Cutlet
plating.note: left side, slightly overlapping the pasta

data.name: Seared Salmon
data.description: Crispy-skin salmon with lemon caper butter and charred broccolini.
data.sellingLine: Crispy skin and a bright lemon caper butter. Light, and full of flavor.
talkingPoints: Cooked medium unless the guest asks.
data.say: “Crispy skin and a bright lemon caper butter. Light, and full of flavor.”
data.inspiration: A lighter main built around a crisp skin and a bright sauce.
sellingPoints: Skin seared crisp, centre medium unless asked

steps.title: Season
steps.detail: Pat the skin dry and salt it.

steps.title: Sear
steps.detail: Skin down in a hot pan; press flat for the first 30 seconds.

steps.title: Finish
steps.detail: Flip for the last minute; rest skin up.

steps.title: Plate
steps.detail: Potatoes, salmon skin up, salsa verde beside.

plating.name: Salsa verde
plating.note: spooned beside, not on the skin

data.name: 12 oz NY Strip
data.description: Grilled New York strip with roasted garlic butter and rosemary potatoes.
data.sellingLine: A 12-ounce strip off the grill with garlic butter. Ask how they like it cooked.
data.say: “A 12-ounce strip off the grill with garlic butter. Ask how they like it cooked.”
data.inspiration: The steakhouse cut, seasoned simply and finished with herb butter.
sellingPoints: Cooked to temperature, rested before slicing

steps.title: Season
steps.detail: Salt heavily and rest at room temp for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Sear
steps.detail: Sear hard on every side in a cast-iron pan.

steps.title: Finish
steps.detail: Into the oven to temperature; baste with butter.

steps.title: Rest and slice
steps.detail: Rest 5 minutes, slice against the grain.

data.name: Bone-In Pork Chop
data.description: A thick-cut pork chop with apple mostarda and creamy polenta.
data.sellingLine: A thick, juicy chop with sweet-tart apple mostarda.
data.say: “A thick, juicy chop with sweet-tart apple mostarda.”
data.inspiration: A thick chop brined overnight, so it stays juicy.

steps.title: Brine
steps.detail: Brine the chops in salt, sugar and herbs overnight.

steps.title: Sear
steps.detail: Pat dry and sear the fat cap first, then both sides.

steps.title: Roast
steps.detail: Finish in the oven to 145°F; rest.

steps.title: Plate
steps.detail: Polenta, chop leaning on it, jus over, mostarda on top.

plating.name: Pork chop
plating.note: leaning on the polenta, bone up

data.name: Tiramisu
data.description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers, mascarpone cream and cocoa.
data.sellingLine: Made in house every morning: espresso, mascarpone and cocoa.
talkingPoints: Contains raw egg and a splash of liqueur.
data.say: “Made in house every morning: espresso, mascarpone and cocoa.”
data.inspiration: Made the traditional way, in a pan, and cut to order.
sellingPoints: Contains raw egg, dairy, gluten and coffee
Pairs with an espresso or a dessert wine

steps.title: Build
steps.detail: Layer espresso-dipped ladyfingers and mascarpone cream in the pan.

steps.title: Set
steps.detail: Chill at least six hours.

steps.title: Cut
steps.detail: Cut with a hot knife, wiping between cuts.

steps.title: Finish
steps.detail: Dust with cocoa, top with shavings.
